Comment: Scheduled bronze ingestion. Retries are declared here rather than buried in the function so the policy is visible in the console and changeable without a redeploy.

Ingest.Comment: One OpenSky snapshot into the bronze prefix.

Retry.Comment: Rate limiting and transient upstream failure. The function already backs off within an invocation; this covers the case where the whole window was unavailable.

IngestSucceeded.Comment: The task result carries bucket, key, state count and provenance, so a successful execution is self-describing in the console.

IngestFailed.Comment: Fails loudly. A schedule that silently swallows errors looks healthy while producing nothing, which is worse than a visible red execution.
IngestFailed.Cause: Bronze ingestion did not complete after retries; see the execution history for the underlying error.
